user_query: I'm organizing a cybersecurity workshop and need to demonstrate DNS lookup capabilities. Can you provide me with the DNS records (A, MX, CNAME) for the domain name 'example.com'? Additionally, I would like to perform a reverse DNS lookup for the IP address '192.168.1.1' to gather more information.

TaskList.description: Fetch DNS records (A, MX, CNAME) for the domain 'example.com'.
Perform a reverse DNS lookup for the IP address '192.168.1.1'.
